title: Once Twice
summary: Given an integer array nums, where exactly one element appears once, another element appears twice, and all other elements appear exactly three times, return an integer array of length 2.
statement: Given an integer array nums, where exactly one element appears once, another element appears twice, and all other elements appear exactly three times, return an integer array of length 2. The first element of the array should be the one that appears once, and the second element should be the one that appears twice. Your solution must run in O(n) time and use O(1) space.
constraints: Exactly one signed 32-bit integer appears once, another appears twice, and every other value appears three times.
Use linear time and constant auxiliary space.
reference_solution:
def find_once_and_twice(nums):
    mask32=(1<<32)-1;ones=twos=0
    for value in nums:
        value&=mask32;twos|=ones&value;ones^=value;common=ones&twos;ones&=~common&mask32;twos&=~common&mask32
    distinguishing=(ones|twos)&-(ones|twos);group=[[0,0],[0,0]]
    for value in nums:
        value&=mask32;index=1 if value&distinguishing else 0;one,two=group[index];two|=one&value;one^=value;common=one&two;group[index]=[one&~common&mask32,two&~common&mask32]
    if ones&distinguishing:once,twice=group[1][0],group[0][1]
    else:once,twice=group[0][0],group[1][1]
    def signed(value):return value-(1<<32) if value>>31 else value
    return [signed(once),signed(twice)]

hints: Bit counts modulo three reveal bits exclusive to the once and twice values; any such bit separates the two exceptions into different groups.
Use two bit-state accumulators, split by one differing bit, then recover the modulo-three residue in each group according to its known frequency.
Compute global ones/twos states, choose a bit from their union, run the same states per bit group, and convert 32-bit results back to signed integers.
Triplicate values vanish modulo three in each group; the separating bit identifies which group contains the once-occurring versus twice-occurring exception.
